name: Cartesian Products Preserve and Reflect Spread Ampleness
statement: For nonempty ample classes on disjoint coordinate sets, the Cartesian product is spread ample if and only if both factors are spread ample.
proof: Every pc-minor of a product is a product of pc-minors of the factors, and both diameter and the optimal spreading diameter add under products. Conversely, each factor and each of its pc-minors occurs by fixing the other factor to one concept.
